fields.Name: T253 - Tags Rebuild Stale Embeddings
fields.Description: Exercises the tag-embedding rebuild action (RebuildEmbeddings) — a distinct long-running maintenance operation separate from the vector sync and pipeline paths.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo) and click 'Tags'. Switch to the 'Health' section in the left nav. In the Health section header, click the 'Rebuild stale embeddings' button. Success is that the action is accepted — the button enters a 'Rebuilding…' spinner/disabled state, OR a completion/status message appears (a no-stale-embeddings result also counts). You do NOT need the rebuild to finish. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Tags Health section renders with its run bar / health cards and a 'Rebuild stale embeddings' button
Clicking Rebuild transitions the button to a Rebuilding/disabled state or produces a status/completion message
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
